title: Deeper/broader DXF view-family reference-graph and peer-contract audit
scope: VIEW, VPORT, VIEWPORT, LAYOUT, and PLOTSETTINGS reference carriers
shade-plot mode/API versus published DXF reference discrepancy
Background, SUN, LiveSection, VisualStyle, and drag-style graph ownership
local typed-field parsing, serialization, remapping, and adapter closure

sources.finding: Documents mode 170 values 0-3 and distinct optional 332 background, 333 shade target, 348 VisualStyle, 361 SUN, plus 335/343/344/91 references for layer-per-viewport overrides.
Documents VPORT shade setting 170 and optional 332, 333, and 348 fields; the local DRW_Vport model has no mode-170 or target-333 member/path.
Documents VIEW references 332 background, 334 live section, 348 VisualStyle, and 361 SUN.
Current ShadePlotType enum defines modes 0-5, including VisualStyle (4) and RenderPreset (5), while published DXF tables list only 0-3.
Modes AsDisplayed/Rendered null the target; VisualStyle/RenderPreset require VisualStyle/RenderSettings objects. This does not establish release-specific serialized DXF examples.
Identifies 333 ShadePlot, 334 LiveSection, 348 VisualStyle, 349 DragVisualStyle, and 361 SUN as separate code roles.
Backgrounds reside in ACAD_BACKGROUND and should not be shared among viewports; concrete-class list and prose differ in breadth.
SUN is a hard-owned child of AcDbViewportTableRecord or AcDbViewport.
Non-root objects have owners; dictionary and entity/table-record ownership differs from ordinary pointer reachability.
Separate viewport reference properties support field-level structural cross-checking, not DWG or native rendering qualification.
LibreDWG's schema offers a useful separate field model but does not independently prove all graph owners or consumer semantics.
Reviewed public model does not establish modern shade-mode graph qualification.
Project states a VIEWPORT coverage exclusion; not a comparator for this family.

confirmed_gaps: DRW_Viewport::parseCode assigns code 349 into shadePlotHandle, while writeViewport serializes that member as code 333.
DRW_Viewport has no dedicated code-334 LiveSection field/parser route.
DRW_Vport lacks shade-plot mode-170 and target-333 typed/parser/writer fields despite the Autodesk VPORT DXF table.
writeView emits background 332, LiveSection 334, and SUN 361 handles without remapping those references.
writeVport emits background 332 and SUN 361 without remapping those references.
dx_iface has no retained typed Background/SUN collections or callback overrides; the adapter graph guard covers paper-space VIEWPORT 332/361 but not equivalent VIEW/VPORT references.
existing_closures: Rooted VisualStyle closure for VIEW, VPORT, and VIEWPORT references.
A bounded VIEWPORT shade mode-4 VisualStyle route.
A VIEWPORT mode-5 RenderSettings graph check for the bounded DXF route.
unresolved_contracts: Per-release DXF serialization and target-version gates for shade modes 4/5.
Exact LiveSection target class/root/version and null/absence policy.
Background concrete class/version set and ownership edge details.
Whether VIEW/VPORT SUN fields follow the same ownership contract as VIEWPORT/VPORT table records.

implementation_sequence: Separate VIEWPORT code 349 from code 333 and add generated ASCII/Binary remap/readback controls.
Add VPORT mode 170/code 333 fields and keep modern mode output blocked pending release-specific wire evidence.
Complete one context-sensitive graph matrix across VIEW, VPORT, VIEWPORT, LAYOUT, and PLOTSETTINGS.
Retain typed/raw Background and SUN objects; validate dictionary roots and hard-owner relations before positive output.
Preplan/remap every supported view-family reference and reject unclosed fields before publication.
Use generated temporary controls, strict touched target, compatibility target, focused selector, and owning CTest; no new persistent fixture files.
